count.subject: How we count.
count.text: For each deck, we take its win rate against each of the top 24 decks. We weight each one by how often you expect to meet that deck. A mirror match counts as 50%. So does a matchup with fewer than 20 matches, and it widens the bar.

bars.subject: The bars.
bars.text: Each bar shows where the true rate most likely is. Blue is clearly above 50%, red is clearly below, grey is too close to call.

pick.subject: Our pick.
pick.text: The deck with the best rate. When other decks are too close to tell apart, we name them too, up to three.

outside.subject: Decks outside the top 24.
outside.text: About a quarter of the decks played are outside the top 24. We have no matchup data for them, so we leave them out. That is why these rates are a little lower than each deck’s overall win rate.
